name: stations
label: Stations · Snow telemetry (N. America)
truth_note: Ground truth comes from NRCS SNOTEL telemetry — automated snow pillows and depth sensors high in the mountains, QC’d and voided (for everyone) when sensors glitch.

name: observers
label: Observers · Measured new snow (N. America)
truth_note: Truth is measured new snow from volunteer and NWS observers (CoCoRaHS + NWS COOP, via NOAA GHCN-Daily): a person, a snowboard and a ruler every morning. A day's snow is the next morning's report. Scores resolve ~6 days after each round, once late reports are in.

name: resorts-na
label: Resorts · North America
truth_note: Truth is each resort’s own published snow report, archived twice daily from the resort’s site. Resort numbers run generous — but every team is scored against the same report, so it’s a fair fight; cross-check the ERA5 league for the reanalysis view.

name: alps
label: Alps · New snow (SLF, MeteoSwiss, GeoSphere, Météo-France, DWD, Tirol, Italian Alps)
truth_note: Truth is the 24h new snow (HN) measured by the WSL Institute for Snow and Avalanche Research SLF — observers' snowboards at manual study plots across the Swiss Alps (Zermatt, Verbier, St. Moritz, Davos…) plus SLF's automatic IMIS stations, and hand measurements at GeoSphere Austria's climate stations (St. Anton, Obergurgl, Saalbach…). Data © SLF and © GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0.

name: japan
label: Japan · Snow-depth sensors (JMA AMeDAS)
truth_note: Truth is the daily snowfall total (降雪の深さの合計) from the Japan Meteorological Agency's automatic snow-depth sensors at AMeDAS stations (Sukayu/Hakkoda, Kutchan/Niseko, Hakuba, Nozawa, Myoko…): the sum of each hour's rise in snow depth over the JST day. Source: 気象庁ホームページ (Japan Meteorological Agency).

name: nordic
label: Nordic · Morning snow depth (SMHI, FMI, MET Norway)
truth_note: Truth is new snow from the daily morning snow-depth reading at Swedish (SMHI), Finnish (FMI) and Norwegian (MET Norway) weather stations (Sälen, Storlien, Saariselkä, Salla, Hemsedal, Oppdal…): the rise in depth between two morning readings. Data © SMHI, © Finnish Meteorological Institute and MET Norway (frost.met.no), CC BY 4.0.

name: world
label: World · Morning snow (DWD, Météo-France, ČHMÚ, WMO stations)
truth_note: Truth is the morning snow reading at mountain weather stations: new snow measured on a board where the station has one (DWD observers in the Black Forest, Bavarian Forest, Fichtelgebirge, Erzgebirge and Harz; ČHMÚ in the Krkonoše, Jizera and Krušné hory; Météo-France ski-resort posts in the Pyrenees), otherwise the rise in snow depth to the next morning's reading (WMO stations via NOAA GHCNh in the Low Tatras and Palandöken; Météo-France stations in the Pyrenees, Massif Central, Vosges, Jura and Corsica; ECCC climate stations in the Canadian Rockies and Columbia Mountains). Data: NOAA NCEI GHCNh (CC0 1.0), Deutscher Wetterdienst (CC BY 4.0), © ČHMÚ (CC BY 4.0), Météo-France (Licence Ouverte 2.0), Environment and Climate Change Canada (OGL – Canada).

name: era5
label: ERA5 · Andes / NZ / AU
truth_note: Truth is ERA5 model analysis at each resort’s coordinates (no public southern-hemisphere station API exists — real feeds get promoted as they become available). Scores resolve about a week after each round.

name: resorts
label: Resorts · Southern Hemisphere
truth_note: Truth is each resort’s own published snow report, archived twice daily from the resort’s site. Resort numbers run generous — but every team is scored against the same report, so it’s a fair fight; cross-check the ERA5 league for the reanalysis view.
